intro: Covers the US session of Thursday 12 November (closed about 08:00 Sydney). Some Australian figures could not be verified and are marked "not available".
footnotes: US index and VIX figures are Yahoo Finance closing quotes. VIX % change is Yahoo's quoted figure (prior close 17.49 vs 17.61 reported by FNArena). The 10-year yield is Yahoo's ^TNX (5.10%; Trading Economics showed 5.13%), with the change measured from FNArena's 5.00% (US bond market was shut for Veterans Day on 11 Nov). AUD/USD, Brent, gold and iron ore are Trading Economics CFD-based reference prices (single source); Yahoo gold futures were US$3,879.00 (-3.04%).

setup.summary: SPI 200 futures: two sources (TradingView 9,127, -0.26%; Investing.com Dec contract 9,132.5, -0.28%) agree on direction, down roughly 0.27%, level about 9,127-9,133. Neither shows a reliable timestamp and may reflect the Thursday day session rather than the post-US-close price, so treat as approximate. This implies a modestly lower ASX 200 open of about -0.27%; implied points are not available because the prior ASX 200 close could not be verified (sources gave about 9,147 and about 9,082 for Thursday; Wednesday's close was 9,153.20, +0.27%).

local_events: Not available (the calendar source was members-only).
what_moved: US stocks ended lower after a volatile session. Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned and the stock fell as much as 14% before closing about 4% lower, while Broadcom and AMD rose. Hotter-than-expected October CPI, markets pricing about a 90% chance of a December Fed hike, and a rise in oil after President Trump's comments on Iran pushed the 10-year yield above 5.1%. Gold fell almost 3% and the US dollar strengthened, taking AUD/USD to a nine-month low.

news.headline: Nvidia CEO resigns
news.summary: Jensen Huang stepped down amid a US investigation; CFO Colette Kress was reported as interim CEO. Nvidia reports earnings on 17 November.

news.headline: Fed hike pricing builds
news.summary: October CPI was hot (core +0.3% m/m versus 0.2% expected) and markets price roughly a 90% chance of a 25 bp hike in December.

news.headline: Oil jumps
news.summary: Brent rose about 3.6% to near US$96/bbl after Trump said the US no longer needs an Iran deal.

news.headline: Gold slides
news.summary: Spot gold dropped about 2.9% to roughly US$3,873/oz on a stronger dollar and hike expectations.

news.headline: Australian dollar at nine-month low
news.summary: AUD/USD fell 0.6% to about 0.6805 as the US dollar index hit a 19-month high.

news.headline: RBA peak debate
news.summary: The RBA cash rate is 4.85% after five hikes in 2026; markets imply about 82% odds that rates have peaked.

news.headline: Small caps weaker
news.summary: The Russell 2000 fell 1.7%; US jobless claims were 200k and existing home sales 3.75m.

coming_up: Nvidia reports earnings on 17 November. The date of the next major scheduled macro release was not verified: not available.
